children.title: pythia

children.subtitle: The shared scientific AI system
children.summary: Pythia turns complex data, simulations, and measurements into fast, interpretable surrogate predictions with calibrated uncertainty and applicability-domain checks.
children.body: Pythia is the shared calyr.aí system for scientific machine learning, surrogate modelling, and prediction. Every prediction combines a predicted response, calibrated uncertainty, applicability-domain status, model provenance, and traceable evidence. Pythia marks unsupported requests for review instead of presenting them as ordinary results, then supplies the controlled predictive core of every application.

children.title: philosophy
children.tile_summary: interpretable models, traceable predictions, human-controlled decisions
children.subtitle: Principles for scientific AI
children.summary: calyr.aí makes model behavior, evidence, uncertainty, and responsibility visible.
children.body:
Traceability — Every result connects to its data, model version, assumptions, and validity range.
Validation — Accuracy and limitations are measured against defined evidence and use conditions.
Uncertainty — Predictions expose confidence, sensitivity, and conditions where the model should not decide.
Human oversight — People remain able to understand, challenge, override, and stop the system.
Lifecycle risk management — Risks are monitored from development through deployment and continued use.
